editorial: We did not retain a full expense sheet, but Bolivia was inexpensive in everyday terms and disproportionately expensive in the specific logistics required to reach and tour Uyuni.
The trip is a stack of flights, buses and a guided salt-flat excursion. Local food and basic accommodation were not the budget problem.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: We'd buy comfort in transit: better accommodation before and after the overnight buses, and we'd take the three-day salt-flat/Laguna Colorada circuit with a reputable operator.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: Keep the same route but stay simple. Bolivia is one of the easier places to cut accommodation and food costs without sacrificing the headline experience. The salt-flat tour is the thing not to economise into unreliability.
